name: Ellic's Exercise Class
summary: This is a VR exergame called “Ellic’s Exercise Class”. Ellic will guide you through the play. The game includes seven mini exercise games: blocking, goalkeeper, volleyball, archery, skeet, baseball, and shooter. You will interact with virtual objects by moving your body and arms and triggering sporting events with the handheld controllers. Join Ellic's Exercise Class today! Each mini-game has three difficulty levels, and there must be a level right for you!
